verdict.rationale: Trivy is a dependency/SCA scanner, so reachability-based prioritization is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows only lock-file and image vulnerability detection, with nothing on reachability or call-graph analysis of vulnerable code. The supply-chain incident items are off-topic and were ignored.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can prioritize dependency alerts by whether the vulnerable code is actually reachable from my code
